messages:
karen-support: FYI ticket #7890 from BrightPath Health — they want streaming chat that can emit structured tool/function calls and JSON frames to our webhook endpoint. Key asks: stable typed schema for each chunk, ordered delivery, function call metadata inline, and ability to resume partial streams if client reconnects. They also need schema versioning and a header to identify frame type.

karen-support: Customer use case: real-time clinical triage assistant. High throughput during clinic hours (~50 concurrent sessions, bursts to 200). Must keep UI showing partial actionable suggestions (i.e. incremental tool invocations).

karen-support: Link to ticket + config: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/7890 — attached sample payloads from customer in the ticket.

jess-product: Thanks — a few clarifying q's: 1) Do they require every token framed, or can we send coarse-grained JSON chunks (e.g., semantic increments)? 2) Are function/tool invocations expected to be synchronous in-stream or emitted as separate webhook events? 3) What is acceptable latency per chunk (50ms, 200ms, 500ms)?

karen-support: They said coarse-grained JSON frames (partial semantic updates ok). Function calls should be emitted inline as frames (so the client can trigger local actions) — they want <500ms chunk arrival in normal conditions.

mike-eng: High-level feasibility notes: combining streaming + structured frames + fncall semantics + reconnect/resume reliably is doable but not trivial. Main concerns: framing semantics (we need a deterministic boundary), backpressure over webhooks, ordering guarantees on retries, and backward compatibility with current streaming API.

mike-eng: Suggest MVP: 1) framing envelope with "event" and "seq" fields, 2) support three event types: partial, fn_call, final, 3) server keeps a short KV-backed history for resume within N seconds. That avoids large design changes to runtime initially. Rough estimate: spike (1wk) + implementation (3 sprints) for hosted API + webhook delivery path.

sara-sales: Heads up — BrightPath is evaluating Dedicated and we could lock them if we support in-Q next quarter. ARR ~$250k committed plus POC. If we prioritize this, sales will push conversion. Recommend we mark as sales-priority. :eyes:

jess-product: Noted. We need VOE (value on contract) to justify pulling into roadmap. Sara can you add an official commercial note + timeline? Also we need clear launch criteria: schema RFC, contract compatibility (old streams keep working), latency SLOs, and an SDK contract for clients.

alan-ux: Also add acceptance criteria: example UIs that consume chunk frames without reordering, docs with sample code, and a compatibility mode flag in the response header (e.g. "X-Stream-Schema: v1"). UX needs sample payloads to prototype.

karen-support: I've uploaded customer sample flows and a short video to the ticket. They want a short sync next Tue to review proposals.

mike-eng: I'll take the spike. Plan: produce an RFC with framing proposal + wire examples (including a small code sample for webhook consumer) in 10 working days. If RFC looks good, we can estimate full implementation.

mike-eng: Example wire snippet (proposal):

```json
{"event":"partial","seq":42,"payload":{"type":"content","text":"Patient may be eligible for med X"}}
{"event":"fn_call","seq":43,"payload":{"name":"lookup_med","args":{"term":"med X"}}}
{"event":"final","seq":44,"payload":{"summary":"Recommend action: run vitals check"}}
```

jess-product: Decision for triage: create a product RFC ticket and label it "customer-request/streaming-fncall-structured". Priority: high (sales-influenced) but scope: MVP per mike's framing plan. Owner: mike-eng (spike). Due: 10 business days for spike deliverable.

sara-sales: I'll add the commercial note and confirm PO timing by EOD.

alan-ux: I'll draft sample payloads for the SDK and a small mock UI to validate UX assumptions; will sync with mike after RFC.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: RFC-1234 (customer-streaming-fncall-struct) — https://prod.redwood.ai/rfcs/RFC-1234

jess-product: I'll slot RFC-1234 into the next planning board as "needs estimate" and tag for review at next triage. Thanks everyone — keep the customer sync on calendar.

karen-support: Customer meeting scheduled Tues 10am PST. I'll prep slide with proposed framing from the RFC when it's ready.
